My dear [Miss Erskine](../persons.html#489)
I have asked Ivanovna to write to you herself as what I know comes chiefly from her.

She is [Miss Johanna Batty](../persons.html#126), I believe her father was a general, and she is very learned in all charities.[^1]
In haste yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Ivanovna ontributed to the MP 1861-1891, but chiefly in the 1860s.

She wrote on such topics as Needlewoman’s Institution, Mission Work at Home, Industrial Charities.
